title: Install and preflight the clarified Codex proposal trigger

requirement.summary: Build and hash the exact reviewed working source, replace only the existing isolated AgentGov pipx runtime, and verify the installed Adapter exposes the six-tool proposal-review surface with the clarified matching-task trigger.

objective.rationale: The trigger clarification is source-validated but the existing installed runtime predates that metadata change. Local installed-runtime identity and discovery must be re-established before any separately authorized external replay.

goal: Install the exact clarified Adapter 1.3.0 working source into the pre-existing AgentGov pipx environment and complete local installed-runtime preflight without starting Codex or sending a replay.
non_goals: Do not change source behavior, task schema, MCP protocol, native form, decision mapping, project Codex configuration, release identity, or human authority.
Do not create another environment, download dependencies, modify another repository, or represent the local 0.3.0rc1-identified wheel as the immutable published artifact.
Do not start Codex, call the OpenAI service, send repository context externally, run a live replay, or implement any proposed downstream task.
Do not commit, push, publish, release, deploy, merge, or modify a consumer repository.
acceptance_signals: The exact reviewed working source is built offline into a local-only 0.3.0rc1-identified wheel, and its size and SHA-256 are recorded.

Only the existing AgentGov pipx environment is updated, without dependency download or creation of another environment; any lock handling targets only read-only-identified AgentGov governance-MCP processes.

The installed package and source governance_mcp.py content match, and installed discovery reports package 0.3.0rc1, Adapter 1.3.0, protocol 2026-07-28, six tools with form capability, and five without it.
Installed server instructions and proposal-tool metadata contain the matching-task, unrelated measurement-only task, and read-only trigger boundaries.
The project Codex configuration is byte-for-byte unchanged, no external replay occurs, and task, scope, repository, documentation, regression, and diff validation report no new unresolved failure.

items: Replacing the shared isolated pipx runtime may encounter a lock held by an existing AgentGov MCP process.
The local package identity remains 0.3.0rc1 and could be confused with the immutable published artifact unless the local-only boundary and exact hash are recorded.
A source/install mismatch could create false readiness evidence unless installed content and metadata are checked independently.
Starting Codex would cross the separately controlled external-replay boundary.

stop_conditions: Stop if the exact working source cannot be built offline and hash-recorded or if installation would require a dependency download or new environment.
Stop if the existing project configuration changes, an unrelated process must be stopped, or installed files cannot be tied to the exact source.
Stop on any installed version, Adapter identity, protocol, discovery, trigger-metadata, privacy, task, repository, regression, or diff failure before declaring preflight complete.
Stop before starting Codex, external replay, downstream implementation, Git write, publication, release, deployment, or consumer mutation.

decision.rationale: On 2026-08-09, after reviewing the completed trigger clarification and the proposed next-step boundary, the human product owner explicitly directed the Agent to perform the installation and local preflight. The exact source was built, hash-recorded, installed only into the existing AgentGov pipx environment, and passed installed and source validation without changing project configuration or starting Codex. The task is now paused so it cannot authorize a live replay, downstream implementation, Git, publication, release, or deployment.
